registered_at: 2026-07-17, before any stage 11/12/13 continuation was generated
question: Is the verbalized self-correction signal SUFFICIENT to induce revision / rescue a wrong intended answer? (mirror of the pre-registered necessity test)

populations.wrong_point: matched 'intended answer wrong, far from every event' truncations of the informative-event chains (chains that self-corrected elsewhere; base rescue rate expected high — ceiling-bounded)
populations.failed_chain: mid-trace truncations of chains whose final answer is wrong (never rescued; no ceiling — the clean sufficiency population)

stage_11_text_insertion.design_notes: insertion points snapped to sentence starts; three phrasing variants dissociate the reconsideration FORM from asserted error INFORMATION; all arms one backend (vLLM), shared seeds, K=8

stage_12_hooked_sufficiency.dose: clamp value = scale x median in-span max activation of the primary feature; alpha = scale x raw diff-in-means norm; window = median informative-event span, event_only
stage_12_hooked_sufficiency.manipulation_check: an arm counts as a valid dose only if its marker-induction rate (continuation verbalizes a lexicon marker within 240 chars) is >= 2x the natural_at_insert rate; otherwise the arm bounds only the tested dose, and the dose ladder result is reported as such

stage_13_activation_shift.metric: 1 - cos(mean resid[t0-w:t0], mean resid[t1+1:t1+1+w]) at layers {15,19,23}, windows {8,16,32} (primary 16); controls are sentence-start pseudo-spans, decile-matched, clear of all events
stage_13_activation_shift.inference: chain-level sign-flip permutation; significant iff p < 0.01 at the primary window
stage_13_activation_shift.aurocs: direction-projection at onset and shift magnitude vs wrong_to_right / flipped labels

decision_rules.sufficient: delta = acc(arm) - acc(in-family reference) >= +0.30 on the held-out test split, AND insert_filler / the manipulation-check-passing dose shows the effect is specific (filler within ±0.10 of reference)
decision_rules.not_sufficient: TOST equivalence within ±0.10 on the test split for every correction arm that passes its manipulation check
decision_rules.inconclusive: anything else (e.g. no arm passes the manipulation check at any dose)

splits: same deterministic pilot/test chain split as the necessity test (pilot_fraction=0.3, split_seed=17); test split examined only after this file was written
seeds: continuation base_seed=91, K=8, shared across all arms of a family
interpretation_notes: wrong_point deltas are ceiling-bounded by the natural rescue rate; failed_chain is the primary sufficiency estimand
induction-without-accuracy-gain (markers induced, answers unchanged) counts as evidence FOR decorative: the signal is producible but not answer-relevant
a positive insert_correction effect that appears ONLY for v=assert_mistake and not v=soft_recheck/v=minimal_marker indicates the INFORMATION 'an error exists' helps, not the verbalization form
